desc: 冬季儿童加厚连帽棉服：毛领帽兜、夹棉内里、防风外层、宽松耐穿
leaf: 儿童冬季连帽毛领加厚棉服
name: 儿童冬季连帽毛领加厚棉服款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，完整展示棉服轮廓并保持平台合规
一秒传达冬季保暖核心卖点，用深绿海报场拉开视觉主张
放大普通棉服臃肿塌型、孩子的冬日臃肿感痛点，引出有型版型
用分层结构图讲清外层、夹棉、内里三层构造，建立专业感
让家长代入孩子冬日户外穿着的真实场景与安全感
微距证明毛领与羊羔绒内里的用料质感，打消面料疑虑
同框对照证明立体剪裁的上身挺括度，呼应有型不易垮塌
用空白尺码卡位消除选码疑虑，实际数值留给投放时填入
以车缝工艺特写与空白洗护标位降低决策风险
暖色收口促单，留出按钮与促销位由投放侧填入真实信息

style.backgroundSystem: pale sage-white sweep #EAF0EA for packshot and comparison panels, pine-green poster field #35604C for benefit and spec screens, oat board #F1EBDD for structure and trust screens, honey-ochre #D98F4E for the closing screen only
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons in a single accent color, blank rounded label chips, no filled cartoon icons
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, gentle front key with soft fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars; skimming light reserved for macro texture shots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm winter children's outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pale sage-white #EAF0EA, pine green #35604C, honey ochre #D98F4E and charcoal text #3B352E; bright soft studio lighting with a gentle front key and soft contact shadows; rounded modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end kidswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the garment across the set; garment always fully visible and never clipped
style.surfaceSystem: matte oat-fiber paper board #F1EBDD and smooth matte poster card, no glossy floors
style.typography: rounded modern geometric sans-serif, short headlines only, generous letter spacing
